independent_checks: 308 ordered full-flag rank-two products in A2/B2/C2/G2 against independently reflected Cartesian discriminants
144 ordered products on the two-step A3 flag
Complete 36-entry Gr(2,4) Littlewood-Richardson table, plus independent Cartesian quotient residues
Three nondivisor Gr(2,5) products below top degree; integral h^6=5
Type D4 quadric middle classes and Euler intersections
66 independently checked polynomial lifts, including relabeled B2; linear/BGG method comparisons
28 E7 full/partial-flag degree-two lifts with the discriminant branch forbidden
Poincare pairings, mixed rational classes, powers, contexts, invalid inputs and caches
new_calculus_suite.scope: Independent calculations cover the recorded finite cases. This does not exhaust every rank, parabolic or exceptional product.

limits: Exact rational ordinary cohomology; integral image lattices, equivariant and quantum products are outside scope
Polynomial lifts are chosen linear sections, not unique polynomial inverses or multiplicative sections
Dense high-degree inverses and products can remain expensive; the auto method is a size heuristic
